title: Etale atlas equalizer for module direct image on an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $p:U\to X$ be a surjective etale morphism from an affine scheme $U$. Put $R=U\times_XU$ with projections $p_1,p_2:R\to U$, and let $a=f\circ p:U\to Y$ and $b=a\circ p_1=a\circ p_2:R\to Y$. For every $\mathcal O_X$-module $F$ on the small etale site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], write $F_U=p^*F$ and $F_R=p_1^*F$ (identified with $p_2^*F$ by the canonical fibre-product identification). Then the canonical map $f_*F\to a_*F_U$ identifies $f_*F$ with the kernel of the difference of the two restriction maps $a_*F_U\rightrightarrows b_*F_R$ induced by $p_1$ and $p_2$; equivalently, $0\to f_*F\to a_*F_U\rightrightarrows b_*F_R$ is exact at the first two terms in the category of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules.

source.place: Tag 03M8 (lemma-compute-pushforward), proof and displayed exact sequence; the two maps are the restrictions along the projections U \times_X U \rightrightarrows U.
